key_idea: Classic 'smallest subsequence of distinct characters': keep a stack, and pop a larger top element whenever it still occurs later.
sketch: Precompute the last occurrence of every value. Scan left to right; skip values already on the stack; otherwise pop while top > current and last[top] > i, then push. Each element is pushed/popped at most once, O(n). Pitfall: forgetting the in-stack check or popping an element with no later occurrence. Stress-tested against brute force over all subsequences.
